mapper.sql: select T.id as id, T.title as title, T.description as description, T.notes as notes, T.status as status, T.priority as priority, T.due_date as dueDate, T.reminder_date as reminderDate, T.created_at as createdAt, T.updated_at as updatedAt, T.user_id as userId, U.username as userUsername, U.bio as userBio, U.image as userImage, C.name as categoryName from tasks T left join users U on T.user_id = U.id left join task_categories TC on T.id = TC.task_id left join categories C on TC.category_id = C.id
mapper.select: select T.id from tasks T where T.user_id = #{userId} and T.due_date < #{now} and T.status != 'COMPLETED' and T.status != 'CANCELLED' order by T.due_date asc
